notes: Stops this extension wiping the SiteGiant twin's filenames. Chrome asks every extension about every download in the browser, and this one still answered about the twin's files when its own background worker had gone to sleep - which is exactly when the twin runs. A blank answer is not silence: it tells Chrome to use the name it guessed from the link, which is why those files arrived as download.zip. It now checks who started the download before saying anything.
